50044-romantic-legends-of-spain.title: Romantic Legends Of Spain
50044-romantic-legends-of-spain.creator: Unknown
50044-romantic-legends-of-spain.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. The writer of these tales was a young poet, oppressed by illness, care and poverty. His brief life held many troubles. Born in Seville, February 17, 1836, of a distinguished family that came to Andalusia from Flanders at about the end of the sixteenth century, he was but five years old, the fourth of eight little sons, when he lost his father.

arxiv-2007-16145.title: Informationally restricted correlations: a general framework for classical and quantum systems
arxiv-2007-16145.creator: Armin Tavakoli, Emmanuel Zambrini Cruzeiro, Erik Woodhead, Stefano Pironio
arxiv-2007-16145.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Armin Tavakoli, Emmanuel Zambrini Cruzeiro, Erik Woodhead, Stefano Pironio. We introduce new methods and tools to study and characterise classical and quantum correlations emerging from prepare-and-measure experiments with informationally restricted communication. We consider the most general kind of informationally restricted correlations, namely the ones formed when the sender is allowed to prepare statistical mixtures of mixed states, showing that contrary to what happens in Bell nonlocality, mixed states can outperform pure ones.

arxiv-2112-02846.title: Decoherence on Staggered Quantum Walks
arxiv-2112-02846.creator: Raqueline A. M. Santos † and Franklin de L. Marquezino ‡
arxiv-2112-02846.description: Abstract Decoherence phenomenon has been widely studied in different types of quantum walks. In this work we show how to model decoherence inspired by percolation on staggered quantum walks. Two models of unitary noise are described: breaking polygons and breaking vertices.

arxiv-2209-05097.title: Reproducibility in machine learning for medical imaging
arxiv-2209-05097.creator: Olivier Colliot, Elina Thibeau-Sutre, Ninon Burgos
arxiv-2209-05097.description: Abstract Reproducibility is a cornerstone of science, as the replication of findings is the process through which they become knowledge. It is widely considered that many fields of science are undergoing a reproducibility crisis. This has led to the publications of various guidelines in order to improve research reproducibility.

arxiv-2306-07321.title: The Lion, the Witch, and the Wormhole: Ensemble averaging the symmetric product orbifold
arxiv-2306-07321.creator: Joshua Kames-King, Alexandros Kanargias, Bob Knighton, Mykhaylo Usatyuk
arxiv-2306-07321.description: Abstract We consider the ensemble average of two dimensional symmetric product orbifold CFTs Sym N ​ ( 𝕋 D ) \text{Sym}^{N}(\mathbb{T}^{D}) over the Narain moduli space. We argue for a bulk dual given by N N copies of an abelian Chern-Simons theory coupled to topological gravity, endowed with a discrete gauge symmetry exchanging the N N copies.

arxiv-2409-15726.title: Some properties of selectively star-ccc spaces
arxiv-2409-15726.creator: Yuan Sun ∗
arxiv-2409-15726.description: Abstract . In 2013 [ 5 ] , Aurichi introduced a topological property named selectively ccc that can be viewed as a selective version of the countable chain condition (CCC). Later, Bal and Kočinac in [ 9 ] extended Aurichi’s work and defined the star version of the selectively ccc property called selectively k k -star-ccc.

arxiv-2503-12661.title: Extendability of general non-prime K ​ 3 K3 surfaces without Gaussian maps
arxiv-2503-12661.creator: Purnaprajna Bangere, Jayan Mukherjee
arxiv-2503-12661.description: Abstract . In [ BM24 ] , we introduced a new approach to the question of extendability of projective varieties via degeneration to ribbons. In this article we build on these methods to recover optimal results on the extendability of general non-prime K ​ 3 K3 surfaces, classification of non-prime Mukai varieties and irreducibility of their Hilbert schemes.

arxiv-2506-19117.title: PrITTI: Primitive-based Generation of Controllable and Editable 3D Semantic Scenes
arxiv-2506-19117.creator: Christina Ourania Tze, Daniel Dauner, Yiyi Liao, Dzmitry Tsishkou, Andreas Geiger
arxiv-2506-19117.description: Abstract Large-scale 3D semantic scene generation has predominantly relied on voxel-based representations, which are memory-intensive, bound by fixed resolutions, and challenging to edit. In contrast, primitives represent semantic entities using compact, coarse 3D structures that are easy to manipulate and compose, making them an ideal representation for this task.

arxiv-2507-00316.title: μ 2 \mu^{2} Tokenizer: Differentiable Multi-Scale Multi-Modal Tokenizer for Radiology Report Generation
arxiv-2507-00316.creator: Siyou Li, Pengyao Qin, Huanan Wu, Dong Nie, Arun J. Thirunavukarasu, Juntao Yu, Le Zhang
arxiv-2507-00316.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Siyou Li, Pengyao Qin, Huanan Wu, Dong Nie, Arun J. Thirunavukarasu, Juntao Yu, Le Zhang. Automated radiology report generation (RRG) aims to produce detailed textual reports from clinical imaging, such as computed tomography (CT) scans, to improve the accuracy and efficiency of diagnosis and provision of management advice. RRG is complicated by two key challenges: (1) inherent complexity in extracting relevant information from imaging data under resource constraints, and (2) difficulty in objectively evaluating discrepancies between model-generated and expert-written reports.

arxiv-2510-22330.title: Optimal Spatial Anomaly Detection
arxiv-2510-22330.creator: Baiyu Wang, Chao Zheng
arxiv-2510-22330.description: Abstract There has been a growing interest in anomaly detection problems recently, whilst their focuses are mostly on anomalies taking place on the time index. In this work, we investigate a new anomaly-in-mean problem in multidimensional spatial lattice, that is, to detect the number and locations of anomaly “spatial regions” from the baseline.

arxiv-2602-06679.title: A supercongruence fantasy on Fibonacci and Lucas (after Guillera)
arxiv-2602-06679.creator: Wadim Zudilin
arxiv-2602-06679.description: Abstract . Motivated by observations of Guillera we generalise the so-called Ramanujan-type supercongruences to a further level in which the sequences of Fibonacci, Lucas, Apéry numbers and their friends all receive a natural appearance. 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification 11F33 (primary), 11B39, 11B65, 11B83, 11Y55, 33C20 (secondary).

pmc-10713557.title: Development and evaluation of a colorimetric LAMP-based biosensor for rapid detection of a nosocomial infection agent, Citrobacter freundii
pmc-10713557.creator: Hamidreza Mollasalehi, Faezeh Esmaili, Dariush Minai-Tehrani
pmc-10713557.description: Simple and fast diagnosis of Citrobacter freundii which is an important cause of nosocomial infection in human is crucial to achieve early treatment. We have developed and evaluated an optical LAMP-based biosensor for the visual detection of C. freundii for the first time. The efficiency of the assay was investigated and compared to PCR method.

pmc-11372719.title: A potential therapeutic strategy based on acute oxidative stress induction for wild-type NRF2/KEAP1 lung squamous cell carcinoma
pmc-11372719.creator: M. Sánchez-Ortega, A. Garrido, C. Cirauqui, L. Sanz-Gonzalez, M.C. Hernández, A. González-García, K. Obregon, I. Ferrer, L. Paz-Ares, A.C. Carrera
pmc-11372719.description: Extensive efforts have been conducted in the search for new targetable drivers of lung squamous cell carcinoma (LUSC); to date, however, candidates remain mostly unsuccessful. One of the oncogenic pathways frequently found to be active in LUSC is NFE2L2 (NRF2 transcription factor), the levels of which are regulated by KEAP1.

pmc-11557503.title: Addition of Sacubitril/Valsartan to Mineralocorticoid Receptor Antagonist Therapy in Primary Aldosteronism: Effects on Plasma Aldosterone Concentration and Plasma Renin Activity
pmc-11557503.creator: Keisuke Okamura, Masatoshi Matsushima, Yosuke Takamiya, Tetsu Okuda, Hideto Sako, Akihiro Udo, Kenichiro Taniguchi, Shogo Morisaki, Ichiro Imamura, Hidenori Urata, Shin-ichiro Miura
pmc-11557503.description: In the pharmacologic treatment of primary aldosteronism (PA), titration of mineralocorticoid receptor antagonist (MRA) dosing is necessary to reverse the renin suppression caused by high aldosterone levels. However, we often encounter cases in which the plasma renin activity (PRA) does not achieve the target level, even with the maximum dose of MRA.

pmc-13074682.title: Influence of Ultrasound-Assisted and Supercritical CO2 Extraction on Phytochemical Profiles with Antimicrobial and Antioxidant Functionality from Olive Leaves and Olive Pomace
pmc-13074682.creator: Yesuneh Gizaw, María José Benito, María de los Ángeles Rivas, Iris Gudiño, María de Guía Córdoba, Rocío Casquete
pmc-13074682.description: This study evaluated olive leaves from three cultivars (Hojiblanca, Picual, and Arbequina) and olive pomace as complementary sources of bioactive compounds, comparing ultrasound-assisted extraction using organic solvents (UAE) with supercritical CO2 extraction (SFE). The aim was to determine how the plant matrix and extraction method influence phytochemical composition and functional properties, including antioxidant and antimicrobial activity.

pmc-13180462.title: Are We in Control? How Best to Include a Control Group in Interrupted Time Series Designs: A Simulation Study
pmc-13180462.creator: Francesco Manca, Daniel Mackay, Jim Lewsey
pmc-13180462.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). pmc-13202689.title: Rapid differentiation of VLA1553 and wild-type ECSA chikungunya strains in the context of an IXCHIQ vaccination campaign
pmc-13202689.creator: Laura Pezzi, Etienne Frumence, Konrad Wesselmann, Gregory Mollé, Lucie Falgous, Nazli Ayhan, Raphaelle Klitting, Guillaume André Durand, Gilda Grard, Emilie Mosnier, Patrick Gérardin, Antoine Nougairède, Remi Charrel, Marie-Christine Jaffar-Bandjee, Xavier de Lamballerie
pmc-13202689.description: In 2024–2025, Réunion Island experienced a large outbreak driven by East-Central-South African (ECSA)-2 lineage of chikungunya virus (CHIKV), leading to the implementation of a vaccination campaign using live-attenuated IXCHIQ (VLA1553). Currently, distinguishing vaccine-derived viremia from wild-type infection relies on genomic sequencing, which is resource-intensive and not routinely available in many diagnostic laboratories.

pmc-13387061.title: Entrapment of a J-tip guidewire within the pulmonary vein during FARAPULSETM pulsed field ablation: a case report
pmc-13387061.creator: Ken Watanabe, Takanori Arimoto, Yuta Kobayashi, Naoaki Hashimoto, Masafumi Watanabe, Henrike Aenne Katrin Hillmann, Sebastian Feickert, Vera Maslova, Deepti Ranganathan
pmc-13387061.description: BackgroundPulsed field ablation (PFA) is a rapidly adopted technology for atrial fibrillation (AF) ablation and is associated with a favourable safety profile and a low risk of complications. However, mechanical complications have rarely been reported.Case summaryA 37-year-old Asian male with paroxysmal AF underwent PFA using the FARAPULSETM system.

pmc-13415016.title: Molecular Imaging in Pancreatic Cancer: Current Applications and Future Perspectives
pmc-13415016.creator: Yongshun Liu, Kexin Lan, Zhaonan Sun, Wenpeng Huang
pmc-13415016.description: Pancreatic cancer ranks among the most lethal malignancies, characterized by a five-year survival rate of approximately 10%. This dismal prognosis is largely attributable to diagnoses occurring at advanced stages and the inherent limitations of conventional imaging modalities in detecting early lesions, identifying metastases, and assessing tumor heterogeneity.
